name: CRYSTAL-FACE Cloud Particle Imager (CPI) imagery paired with WRF-HYSPLIT thermodynamic back-trajectories
model_or_instrument: Cloud Particle Imager (CPI) on aircraft paired with WRF-AHM and NOAA HYSPLIT
resolution: 2.3 µm pixel size for imagery; 10-minute intervals along 7-hour back-trajectories (L=50 timesteps); WRF nested grids at 25, 5, and 1 km

scales.note: CPI pixel resolution is 2.3 um; WRF domains are 1-25 km across ~2500 km outer domain; 10-min trajectory steps over July 2002 campaign.
